_comment: Difficulty targets for the balance sim (tools/balance_sim.gd, BalanceCurve). Each case is one alert tier of an act, or the boss stub. An act case fights at Escalation.level_for(act, region_defense, alert, fortify) (R2-B, data/tuning/escalation.json): region_defense is the median defense of the act's default map (act 1 lake_washington_12: 2; act 2 north_america_33: 3; act 3 world_20: 3), fortify defaults to 0; the boss names its defense_level. A case plays runs auto-fights of a freshly drafted squad (BotFactory, run i drafts from seed base_seed + i) and checks the win rate against target [low, high] percent. factions: the act's factions (data/combat/factions.json regions), run i fights factions[i % size]; empty plays the generic roster (enemy_tables.json pools), as the boss stub does. The unit tier comes from the defense level through tier_by_act (the difficulty-curve switch in data/variants/variants.json). territory (default: act) picks the difficulty-curve scaling (DifficultyRules; boss is the boss stub's territory). skill_ranks_added: ranks added to every squad skill, a stand-in for the growth a squad has by then. TODO(decision: difficulty-targets): the bands (act 1, the onboarding act with a 3-loss limit: alert 0 85-90%, alert 1 75-85%, alert 2 65-75%; acts 2-3: alert 0 60-70%, alert 1 52-62%, alert 2 45-55%; boss 35-45%, as losing it ends the run), the levels per alert and the growth stand-ins are first guesses.
